[EN] Not Just a Flower Pot
[ES] No es solo una maceta
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please destroy the {@creature:46#7003#haxuul extractor} and get samples.
[ES] Por favor, destruye el {@creature:46#7003#haxuul extractor} y consigue muestras.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Thank you for bringing samples from the {@creature:46#7003#haxuul extractor}.
[ES] Gracias por traer las muestras del {@creature:46#7003#haxuul extractor}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Plant Samples
[ES] Muestras de plantas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Pass through the {@creature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shaman} guarding the rooms in {@Rgn:46002$$Raga Evala} of {@Rgn:46001$$the Three Towers} and destroy the {@creature:46#7003#haxuul extractor}. Then get samples.
[ES] Atraviesa al {@creature:46#202#argonomorph kulkari shaman} que custodia las habitaciones en {@Rgn:46002$$Raga Evala} de {@Rgn:46001$$the Three Towers} y destruye el {@creature:46#7003#haxuul extractor}. Luego consigue muestras.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to the {@Rgn:46020$$Shineroot Chamber} and deliver the collected plant samples to {@linkcreature:246#1024$$Platanok}.
[ES] Regresa a la {@Rgn:46020$$Shineroot Chamber} y entrégale las muestras de plantas recolectadas a {@linkcreature:246#1024$$Platanok}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It's an honor to serve."
[ES] "Es un honor servir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go meet {@creature:246#1026$$Beranie} at the {@Rgn:46015$$Hexheart Chamber}.
[ES] Ve a encontrarte con {@creature:246#1026$$Beranie} en la {@Rgn:46015$$Hexheart Chamber}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
